title: Barcelona tour
text: Great experience and guide Xavi was knowledgeable and funny.  Winery was a lovely experience.  Views were stunning.
author: deborah_y

title: Monserrat failure
text: We were given the wrong info where to meet.  Luckily someone from the Castle Experience finally came out after we had been there 45 mins, to say we needed to go to the bus station after we had taken a taxi to the office.  So we had to walk to the bus station.  When we got to Monserrat, it was so foggy we couldn’t see the mountains nor the buildings.  After paying $175, we felt like we got ripped off.  I realize you can’t control the weather, but why not cancel it since we couldn’t see anything.
author: LindaS_M
